query:
SELECT
                                    kind,
                                    key,
                                    folder_id,
                                    message_id,
                                    sequence,
                                    received_at,
                                    document,
                                    body
                                FROM
                                    imap_state_entries
                                WHERE
                                    link_id = $1
                                    AND kind = 'message'
                                    AND folder_id = ANY ($2)
                                ORDER BY
                                    received_at DESC,
                                    key
                                LIMIT $3
